As Key Account Manager (m/f/d) BELUX , you take full ownership for the commercial growth in the region. Operating with high autonomy and commercial sharpness, your role is to structurally scale commercial activities and key accounts, while ensuring sustainable and solid foundations in the market.

Revenue & Growth: Drive revenue growth by establishing and nurturing relationships with key clients, partners, and distributors, enhancing market share and volume.
Channel Strategy: Develop and execute channel strategy at both a strategic and operational level to further presence across all accounts (including annual terms, promotional calendars, range reviews, and shelf placement).
P&L: Manage the commercial BELUX P&L (revenue, trade, margins, payment terms)
Field Activation: Define the in-store activation strategy and rigorously manage third-party field agencies to execute high-impact store operations (detention, activations).
Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Coordination: Monitor Belgian market and trends while closely collaborating with internal teams on supply chain, finance, marketing, trade.

You have 5–8 years of experience in FMCG , with clear exposure to the Belgian market and proven experience across both account management and trade marketing
You are a commercially driven market expert who knows the BELUX food retail network inside out and that you can activate on day one.
You are a talented negotiator with proven success, and have built or contributed to a pricing or tariff structure before, understanding channel economics and margin waterfall logic
You’re eager to let your entrepreneurial side thrive in an autonomous structure and make an impact, moving easily from contract negotiation to hands-on field steering.
You are fluent in English, French, and Dutch to seamlessly interface with our French team and local Belgian buyers
You are based in Berlin with the flexibility for regular travel across BELUX accounts and to Paris for team alignment
What's In It For You
Smart Working & Flexibility: Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge.
Growth & Setup: A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks.
KoRo Vibe & Benefits: Free snacks, and barista coffee in the office, 20% discount in the KoRo Online-Shop, and exclusive perks with partner companies. On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo.
Shared Moments: Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together.

s.h: We're looking for People who share our Mindset
s.t:
For us, it's not just about the what , but above all about the how . You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset:
You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.
You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.
You build, you don't wait. When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there.
You think in leverage. You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact.
You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind. You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better.
Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others
Sounds good?
Then send us your application and all other relevant documents via our website.
We would appreciate it if you could send your documents in English so that our talent acquisition team can process your application. We are looking for real team members! We are curious to know who you are and what moves you, so feel free to tell us already in a few introductory sentences.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Global System Integrators (GSI) play a crucial role in Canonical growth plans in the coming 3 years. We are hiring a Senior Partner Sales Manager to work closely with Canonical GSI partners throughout their sales cycles and across their sales organizations to facilitate Ubuntu based solutions and opportunities, as well as help GSI build long term digital transformation platforms with Ubuntu stacks and services.
Working the the Partner Sales Director in their geographic region, the Senior Partner Sales Manager will be responsible for building trusted relationships with partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelizing about the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineers to CxO level.

They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and participate in executive engagements as coordinated by the Senior Director.

Build strategic relationships with partners at levels, and stickiness with Ubuntu technology
Deep understanding of Linux and cloud software ecosystem, and open source selling models
Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
Deep understanding of partner organizations and sales models, in particular with Global System Integrators
Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management to deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
Lead executive interlocks between partners and Canonical leadership team
Ability to travel - sometimes internationally - up to 40% of the time

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
Extensive experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
Extensive experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers and other Cloud technologies.
Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with ambitious achievement goals
Excellent communication and presentation skills

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Uber Eats is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Senior Account Executive to help grow our Retail business across the United States.
In this role, you'll play a key part in expanding Uber's retail selection by bringing customers more of the brands they know and love-from nationally recognized retailers and emerging consumer brands to regional favorites and beloved local businesses. You'll prospect, negotiate, and launch new merchant partnerships across categories including Beauty, Fashion, Electronics, Home, Sporting Goods, and Specialty Retail, helping make Uber the go-to destination for consumers looking to shop on-demand.
You'll own the full sales cycle, building relationships with business owners and executive decision-makers, negotiating commercial agreements, and launching merchants onto the Uber platform. Success in this role is measured by consistently exceeding sales goals, bringing high-quality merchants onto the platform, and expanding the retail selection that keeps customers coming back to Uber.

Own the full sales cycle for prospective retail merchants, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting, and launch.
Build and manage a pipeline of new business opportunities across a diverse portfolio of retail merchants, balancing nationally recognized brands, regional retailers, and high-potential local businesses.
Develop relationships with founders, owners, and executive stakeholders to understand their business objectives and demonstrate how Uber can help drive customer acquisition, incremental sales, and omnichannel growth.
Deliver thoughtful, consultative sales presentations tailored to each merchant's business, clearly communicating the value of partnering with Uber.
Negotiate commercial agreements that establish strong, long-term partnerships and create sustainable value for both Uber and our merchant partners.
Partner closely with Operations, Account Management, Marketing, Product, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and successful merchant launches.
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast while consistently achieving or exceeding monthly and quarterly business goals.
Share customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence to help inform Uber's retail growth strategy and identify new partnership opportunities.

5+ years of experience in sales, business development, account management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
2+ years of experience managing a sales pipeline and consistently delivering against quota.
Experience prospecting, negotiating, and closing new business opportunities.
Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
Passion for helping businesses grow through innovative technology and commerce solutions.

Experience selling into retail, ecommerce, SaaS, marketplaces, advertising, logistics, payments, or other commercial technology solutions.
Experience managing consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Proven track record of exceeding quota in a performance-based sales role.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment while helping build new go-to-market motions and sales strategies.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
Coachable, curious, and motivated by building new business.

The problems we work on are complex and high-stakes, requiring precision, adaptability, and a deep understanding of both data and client needs. We’re a collaborative, high-ownership team that moves quickly and takes pride in solving hard problems well.

People at Pattern go deep to understand the “why,” build solutions that hold up, and stay focused on what drives real outcomes for our customers.

We value transparency, thoughtful problem-solving, and authenticity in how we work together and we’re looking for someone who’s excited to contribute to a team that’s actively building and improving every day.

You’ll be responsible for developing a healthy pipeline, leading consultative sales conversations, and delivering tailored solutions that help firms scale their operations through Pattern’s technology.
Target new prospects and manage your own book of business, focusing on both mid-market and enterprise mass tort law firms.
Prospect, qualify, and lead discovery calls and demos to uncover client needs and propose data-driven solutions.
Strategize and implement creative approaches when faced with client challenges that defy easy fixes.
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, decision-makers, and industry partners to support revenue goals.
Create account plans to maximize opportunities within existing and prospective clients, ensuring a recurring and sustainable book of business.
Structure and manage negotiations to successfully close deals and build long-term client partnerships.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Client Success, and Engineering to advocate for client needs, shape feature development, and deliver customized solutions that maximize product adoption and value.
Represent Pattern at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events to strengthen market presence and generate new opportunities.
Travel up to 30% for client meetings, on-site visits, and industry events.
Effectively manage time, prioritize competing objectives, and consistently exceed goals in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

3-6 years of quota-carrying software or technology sales and account management experience.
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas and closing deals with large ACVs (e.g., $50,000-$200,000 in size).
Experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation, with a demonstrated ability to manage full-cycle consultative sales.
Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all decision-making levels.
Comfort navigating complex client environments with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
CRM proficiency (HubSpot preferred) and strong operational discipline in managing pipeline and forecasting.
Strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to turn client challenges into actionable solutions.
Previous experience selling into the legal industry or adjacent verticals is a plus.

s.h: Who Is Wrike and Our Culture
s.t:
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
Hybrid work mode
Wrike is our people, not a place. At ecoATM the proof of our success is in our staggering growth, extraordinary impact on protecting the planet, and providing a work culture unlike any other. We are a technology company and a pioneer of device re-commerce.

Through our 7,000 automated kiosks and online marketplace Gazelle.com, we enable people all over the world to join the mobile device re-use revolution, a revolution that will get billions of used smartphones out of the e-waste cycle and into the hands of people who don’t have affordable access to the empowerment of the latest mobile technology.
At ecoATM we know our employees are our greatest strength and the key to our continued growth and success. When you join our team, you will enjoy more than just a job, you will be empowered to develop and utilize your unique talents and skills to build a rewarding career while making a lasting, positive impact on the planet.

Role Summary ecoATM is looking for an experienced, strategic Senior Manager of Account Management to own and grow a portfolio of our retail partnerships.

This is a senior individual-contributor role built for someone with real account management chops — someone who can dig into the numbers and turn them into a presentation that lands in the room, stay organized while juggling hundreds of store launches at once, transform a chaotic spreadsheet into something genuinely useful, and keep a retailer relationship strong even when things get bumpy.

This role carries all the seniority, scope, and autonomy of a Senior Manager or Director-level account leader — without the people-management load. It's built for someone who wants to stay close to the account, not manage a team. What You Will Do:

Account Ownership: Own the relationship and act as the primary point of contact for your assigned retail accounts.

Account Planning: Build and execute account plans that grow kiosk placements, improve performance, and deepen ecoATM's integration with each partner.

Data-Driven Insights: Analyze retailer and internal performance data to identify issues and build data-backed recommendations for new placements and optimization.

Business Reviews: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews and joint business planning that connect ecoATM's performance to each retailer's own strategic and financial priorities.

Executive & Stakeholder Relationships: Cultivate relationships across a retailer's HQ — merchandising, operations, real estate/asset protection, sustainability — to multi-thread the relationship and reduce single-point-of-contact risk.

Escalation Management: Manage problem resolution with urgency, conducting root-cause analysis and coordinating internally to protect the partnership.

Marketing Partnership : Work with marketing teams to increase kiosk visibility and drive incremental foot traffic within partner locations. Develop and support initiatives that enhance in-store awareness and customer engagement.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with operations & regulatory teams to execute new kiosk installs smoothly.

Market Awareness: Track industry trends and competitive activity, using real-time insight to spot new opportunities within your accounts.

Business Development Support: Partner with the Business Development team on channel expansion opportunities and the onboarding of newly signed accounts within your territory.

Forecasting & Planning : Manage account level installation and removal forecasts

Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of the customer, ensuring retailer feedback shapes product, marketing, and operational decisions.

8+ years of account management, retail partnerships, or related experience, ideally including time at Senior Manager or Director level
Proven record of growing complex, multi-stakeholder retail accounts and hitting revenue/performance targets
Advanced Excel skills; comfortable manipulating and interpreting large datasets
Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM
Strong PowerPoint and executive presentation skills
Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a remote, fast-paced environment
Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, or related field preferred

What is Restaurant Software?
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.
From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.
How we use AI at Tebi
We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Bei GECKO suchen wir Menschen mit Leidenschaft und Engagement, um in den kommenden Jahren weiter wachsen zu können. Im Gegenzug sind wir gern bereit in unsere Mitarbeiter zu investieren, sowohl bei der Arbeit als auch im täglichen Leben.
Bleib flexibel
Uns ist es nicht wichtig, dass du zu einem festen Zeitpunkt im Büro sitzt. Wir wissen, dass Mitarbeiter am produktivsten sind, wenn sie ihre Arbeitsroutine in Einklang mit dem Privatleben bringen können. Ob im Büro oder im Home Office, bei uns kannst du dir den Tag mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten so einteilen, dass er zu deinem Leben passt. Dabei unterstützen wir dich mit modernen Kommunikationstools und einer transparenten Arbeitsplanung.
Bleib fit
Kennst du das auch? Du steckst gerade mitten im Workflow und ein kleines Hungergefühl stellt sich ein. Dafür haben wir vorgesorgt und stellen kostenlos frisches Obst in den Büros bereit und sorgen mit Getränken, wie z.B. Wasser, Kaffee und Mate dafür, dass auch das Trinken nicht zu kurz kommt. So kannst du dich jederzeit stärken und schon geht’s motiviert weiter.
Empfehle und profitiere
Wir sind ständig auf der Suche nach Talenten, die Teil unseres Teams werden möchten. Für Mitarbeiter, die überzeugt sind den perfekten Kandidaten zu kennen, der uns beim Wachsen unterstützen kann und der gut zu uns passt, zahlen wir bei Übernahme eines empfohlenen Mitarbeiters eine Prämie, die sich sehen lassen kann.
Arbeiten und Spaß haben
Wer fleißig gearbeitet hat, darf sich natürlich auch belohnen. In den Pausen oder nach Feierabend kannst du dich gern bei uns in den Chillout Areas zum Quatschen mit den Kollegen treffen oder beim Zocken an der Playstation antreten. Team-Events und Mitarbeiterfrühstück gehören bei uns genauso dazu, wie der kleine Plausch in der Küche, denn stärken wir das Wir-Gefühl und wachsen weiter zusammen.
Um für die täglichen Herausforderungen gewappnet zu sein und den Geschäftserfolg nachhaltig zu stärken, glauben wir nicht nur an Expertise und Erfahrung. Wir glauben vor allem auch an den Zusammenhalt unserer Teams und an eine Kultur, die Respekt, Toleranz und ein faires Miteinander fördert. Wenn du ähnlich tickst wie wir, sind wir schon jetzt sehr gespannt darauf dich kennenzulernen.

s.h: Concrètement, tu pilotes ton activité autour de quatre axes
s.t:
Prospection et développement de portefeuille : C'est le cœur de ta mission. Tu construis et gères ton propre portefeuille de clients de A à Z. Le cold calling est ton levier quotidien pour convaincre et obtenir des rendez\-vous stratégiques avec des responsables d'entreprise.
Analyse de besoin et négociation : Tu rencontres des directeurs et managers pour analyser leurs besoins. Tu établis les profils de candidats recherchés et mènes les négociations tarifaires. Expertise marché et synergie interne : Fort de ta connaissance du terrain, tu apportes un regard éclairé à tes clients. Une fois le besoin identifié, tu travailles en lien étroit avec nos recruteurs.
Rigueur et résultats : Tu es responsable de tes performances. Pour assurer des résultats constants, tu appliques nos méthodes de travail avec précision, du premier contact jusqu'à la conclusion de l'accord (le closing).
Nous cherchons un tempérament, pas un CV
Peu importe tes études ou ton passé professionnel, nous cherchons les traits de caractère suivants :
Le sens de la conviction : Tu n'hésites pas à donner ton avis, même face à une figure d'autorité. Tu préfères une discussion franche au consensus facile.
Une résilience sans faille : L'échec te pousse à redoubler d'efforts. Un "non" n'est jamais une fin en soi, mais le point de départ pour trouver une autre solution.
Le goût de l'accomplissement : Tu as besoin de te fixer des défis pour avancer. Tu aimes la compétition et tu cherches un environnement où tes efforts sont récompensés à leur juste valeur.
Une curiosité naturelle : Tu aimes creuser un sujet pour en comprendre les racines. Tu poses les bonnes questions pour comprendre un problème avant d'agir.
Le sens de l'autonomie : Tu apprécies la liberté d'organiser tes journées et tu sais faire preuve d'une grande rigueur personnelle pour atteindre tes objectifs.

0 à 3 ans d'expérience après la fin de tes études.
Pas besoin d'expérience en Sales : nous te formons de A à Z via notre AW Sales Academy.
Français parfait et niveau avancé en anglais (C1\).

Un écosystème de high\-performers : Un environnement exigeant et stimulant où l'on se tire vers le haut et où les succès sont célébrés ensemble (voyages, kick\-offs).
L'impact comme véritable moteur : Tu auras un impact direct sur le business de tes clients et sur la trajectoire des jeunes talents.
Think big \& make it happen : Un salaire fixe évolutif et un système de commissions totalement déplafonné. Ici, ton ambition est la seule limite.

You'll own a book of roughly 100 existing Enterprise customers across the Northeast — about $4M in ARR — and you'll be measured on what you do with it: how fast customers reach real adoption, how cleanly they renew, and how much you grow them.
This is a high-velocity motion. You're not nursing a handful of accounts through year-long cycles; you're keeping a wide book moving — spotting the renewal that needs attention three quarters early, the team that's underusing what they bought, the adjacent use case nobody's asked about yet. Breadth is the job. The best people in this seat are organized, proactive, and relentless about working the whole book rather than the five accounts that shout loudest.
You're measured against three things, the same three every Enterprise AM is measured against:
Time to value — getting customers to meaningful adoption and depth of use inside what they already own. You drive this; you don't wait for it.
Secure renewal — retention, multi-year capture, and forecast accuracy across your book.
Upsell and cross-sell — expansion within your existing customers: more users, adjacent products, new use cases inside the relationships you already hold.
When an expansion grows large enough that running it well would pull you off the other 99 accounts, you partner with an Account Executive who runs that single cycle while you keep the rest of the book healthy. You source it, set it up, hand it off cleanly, and step back in as the relationship owner when it closes. Knowing when to pass and passing well is part of doing this job at a high level — it's how you protect the book, not a limit on what you close.

You know your book cold — which accounts are healthy, which are quietly at risk, and where the next expansion is hiding — without being asked.
Renewals are forecast accurately and captured early, not scrambled in the final 30 days.
You're generating expansion across the book consistently, not leaning on whichever pillar is easiest.
Your customers describe you as the steady, proactive presence who made the product work for them — not the person who showed up at renewal.

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner?

Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast 's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast 's bottom line.
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
Ability to travel 30% or more.

Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to complete complex RFPs, bonus if you’ve helped write a RFP for a prospect just starting their evaluation process
Experience helping stand up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket.

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.
You should apply if...
You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.h: In your first month, you will
s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
